models.name: #230 Impact Dryer Mill
models.tagline: Grinds, dries and classifies in one air-swept pass — the heart of a complete Williams IDM system.
models.description: The Williams Impact Dryer Mill (IDM) combines grinding, drying and air classification in a single air-swept pass. High-speed hammers reduce the feed while heated process air sweeps moisture out with the fines, so a wet, lumpy feed enters and a dried, classified, controlled-size product leaves. The #230 shown has a 24 in (610 mm) x 30 in (762 mm) rotor and is sold as the heart of a complete IDM system with a dynamic separator for product classification, a venturi for fines pre-stripping, over-rotor drying column, vibratory feeder, heated-air train (high-efficiency fan, duct burner, bag filter, ductwork) and a PLC control package. Representative duty on this unit: 0.5—1 TPH feed rate of minus 1/2 in DRI sludge/fines at up to 15 percent moisture, producing a nominal 1/4 in product dried to 1 percent moisture or less (capacity confirmed by Williams test lab).

models.name: 20x18 Double Roll Crusher
models.tagline: Two smooth rolls, tight gap — low-fines crushing with a clean 4:1 reduction.
models.description: The Williams Double Roll Crusher reduces material by compression between two counter-rotating smooth rolls set to a controlled gap. It is well suited to coal, rock, and other friable material where minimum fines are wanted: the controlled gap limits product top size, and the low-speed roll action avoids the impact-driven fines of a hammer mill. Reduction is limited to about 4:1, so double rolls are typically used as secondary crushers after primary reduction. The 20x18 shown runs 50—100 RPM on the rolls, driven by a 25—40 HP V-belt drive from a 1,200 RPM motor; approximate weight 5,725 lb.

specs.label: Design
specs.value: Two smooth counter-rotating rolls — compression crushing

specs.label: Typical duty
specs.value: Secondary crushing of coal, rock, and friable materials

models.name: 220 Reversible Impactor
models.tagline: High-capacity secondary and tertiary crushing by mid-air impact — with a reversible rotor for extended wear life.
models.description: The Williams Reversible Impactor is a horizontal shaft impactor (HSI) built for high-capacity secondary and tertiary crushing. High-speed hammers strike and accelerate feed against stationary manganese impact blocks, and repeated impacts reduce the material until it passes out through a large, unrestricted discharge opening. The rotor is reversible, so operators can reverse direction to use the opposite working face of each hammer, doubling wear life between change-outs without opening the mill. One-piece cast manganese impact blocks also rotate top-to-bottom to use more wear surface before replacement. Few close tolerances and no cage bars make the design well-suited to wet, sticky, or hard-to-discharge materials that plug other crushers.

models.name: 200 HP Hydraulic Ripshear Shredder
models.tagline: Slow-speed, high-torque disc-cutting — shreds the toughest heavy-duty material quietly and with minimal dust.
models.description: The Williams Ripshear is a slow-speed shredder that reduces material with a scissor-like disc-cutting action — not by tearing or fracturing. Two opposing shafts of toothed cutting disks turn at low speed under high torque, producing minimal dust, noise and vibration and avoiding the windage and ignition sources of high-speed shredders. The hydraulic Ripshear detects jams by actual shaft stoppage rather than a pressure limit, so it uses the full capability of its hydraulic drive and only reverses on a true mechanical jam. On the 200-4456, two 100 HP motors drive the two shafts (one each) at 15 RPM through a 44 x 56 inch feed opening. Needs only a minimal foundation of concrete slabs or equivalent leg support; can be made portable.

models.name: DF-100 Roller Mill
models.tagline: High-capacity fine grinding of coal & minerals — with integral air classification.
models.description: The Williams DF Roller Mill grinds and classifies in a single pass. Spring-loaded rolls crush material against a rotating grinding ring while a built-in centrifugal separator returns oversize for regrinding and carries finished product out with the air stream. Rugged and built for continuous duty, it pulverizes coal and a broad range of minerals to a controlled, classifier-set fineness.

models.name: Single Roll Crusher
models.tagline: Rugged size reduction of minerals and friable materials by impact, shear, and compression.
models.description: Williams Single Roll Crushers reduce friable materials through a combination of impact, shear, and compression against a toothed roll. Simple, low-profile, and easy to maintain, they handle larger feed sizes at high capacity with consistent product size and minimal fines, and have long been used as primary and secondary coal crushers.

specs.label: Design
specs.value: Single toothed roll - impact, shear and compression

models.name: KS Series Hammer Mill
models.tagline: Shreds bark & wood waste by impact — no knives to sharpen.
models.description: The Williams KS-series is a rugged swing-hammer mill for high-capacity size reduction. Fitted with hog hammers it becomes a Williams “No-Nife Hog” for bark and wood waste — no knives to sharpen, so no tool-room labor or sharpening shutdowns — while other hammer configurations handle a broad range of materials with excellent particle-size control and low power per ton. The hopper and base shown are optional — supplied with most mills but not standard equipment.
